requirements.rule: typed issuer, number, title, instrument date, operative clause, amendment chain, institution class, effective date and transition deadline must be separate fields
no historical R-2019/02 capital or prudential percentages executable without authenticated current text, institution profile, independent legal and finance approval
customer safeguarding balances segregated from provider funds and bank settlement positions; include distributors and external holding-bank evidence
independent safeguarding reconciliation and discrepancy cases; preserve historical weekly requirement without asserting current universal frequency
versioned incident classification with multiple R-2024/01 Article 30 criteria; never rely solely on 2019 financial threshold
credit institution, EMF, payment institution and holding must be distinct; licenses are institution- and product-specific
safeguarding or regulatory classification cannot directly mutate posted journal, customer balance, external settlement or liquidity
incident notification and subsequent report due dates are separate legal workflow states with tamper-evident custody
contract, role, scope, tenancy, monitoring and termination controls required before distributor operation
reporting schemas, reporting basis, exemptions and frequency require institution-approved COBAC instructions, not inferred from Art 20
DR replay cannot duplicate safeguarding movements, postings, external settlement claims or regulatory notifications
retain exact conflicting legal wording and signed source hash when obtained; no silent correction of issuer text

conflicts.issue: R-2019/02 current operative text and amendment lineage unverified
R-2024/01 explanatory effective dates versus reproduced operative Article 41
2019 incident threshold not exhaustive against later 2024 multiple-trigger framework
2019/02 safeguarding and reporting cannot be made institution-specific without approval and PCEC

acceptance_scenarios.expected: A credit institution is incorrectly subjected to the payment-institution-specific historical capital rule; institution-type gate must reject.
A historical 2019 minimum-capital figure is activated without authenticated amendment lineage and legal sign-off; reject executable policy.
Tiered prudential percentages are applied to entire volume instead of marginal tranches; detect using independently calculated boundary fixtures.
Electronic-money float and payment-volume requirements are substituted for each other; reject mixed basis.
Article 7 discretionary prudential uplift is applied without an institution-specific COBAC decision; reject.
Customer safeguarding funds are recorded as the provider's unrestricted operating cash; reject accounting classification and alert.
Daily outstanding-payment exposure omits distributor receipts; safeguarding completeness check fails.
Safeguarding bank reconciliation is absent or stale; compliance evidence cannot be marked complete.
A customer funds safeguarding discrepancy is auto-corrected by directly editing a posted journal; reject and require controlled correction.
2019 Article 13 monetary-loss criterion is treated as the only 2026 significant-incident trigger; reject scope-incomplete policy.
An incident affecting a critical function but below monetary thresholds is suppressed; trigger legal-review queue under R-2024/01 Article 30.
An explanatory report's 2026 transition date is stored as the regulation's 2025 legal effective date; reject conflation.
R-2019/01 licensing dossier from a secondary OCR source authorizes a payment product without the institution's actual approval; reject.
An outsourced distributor is given direct posting permissions without contract, scope, maker-checker or per-tenant controls; reject.
Disaster-recovery replay repeats safeguarding movement or reporting submission; idempotency and reconciliation prevent duplicates.
R-2019/03 monetary-sanctions citation is misbound as R-2019/02 prudential authority; citation-integrity gate rejects.
